properties.Query.filters: Filter expression restricting the rows returned by the query

properties.SavedExplorer.uuid: Unique identifier of the saved explorer
properties.SavedExplorer.name: Name of the saved explorer
properties.SavedExplorer.query: Query stored in the saved explorer
properties.SavedExplorer.created_by: User who created the saved explorer
properties.SavedExplorer.modified_by: User who last modified the saved explorer
properties.SavedExplorer.created_date: Date and time the saved explorer was created
properties.SavedExplorer.modified_date: Date and time the saved explorer was last modified
properties.JobResults.job_type: Type of the job, which determines the payload it expects

properties.JobResults.date_created: Date and time the job was created
properties.JobResults.payload: Payload the job was created with
properties.JobResults.crawl_date: Date of the crawl the job relates to
properties.AnalysisSegments.segments: Public metadata of the segments defined for the analysis
properties.ProjectSavedFilter.name: Name of the saved filter
properties.ProjectSavedFilter.filters: Filter expression stored in the saved filter
properties.ProjectSavedFilter.project_name: Name of the project the filter belongs to

properties.DefaultPayload.error: Error details returned by the API
